text: E goɗɗo e mo'on yeloto heɓugol naakoo mo tamarooje e inabuuje; hara canɗi no ila ley ton. Hara himo jogii ton noone kala e dimɗe, nayeegu heɓa mo e ɗum tawa non himo mari geɗalɓe lo'uɓe ɓe waawataa golle, nduluuru ndu yiite heɓa naakoo on ndu sunna fof. Ko kaŋko ɓuri hatonjinnde e ballal sabu nayeegu makko e lo'ere ɓiɗɓe makko?! Ko nii alhaali wiŋtiroowo jawdi mun ndin yiingo wa'iri; o tawoyay Alla ñalnde darngal o alaa baraaji fewndo ka o hatonjini e mu'un. Ko Wano nii Alla Ɓaŋnginiraŋta on kon ko nafata on aduna e laakara, belajo'o on miijitoto.
